# Tool registry reference

See [SPEC §6](../SPEC.md). Policy is enforced by the orchestrator from these same declarations.

| Tool | Interrupt | Scope | Timeout | Confirm | Latency |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `end_session` | cancel | household | 10000ms | no | fast |
| `media_search` | detach | household | 20000ms | no | slow |
| `remember` | cancel | person | 10000ms | no | fast |
| `speak` | cancel | household | 10000ms | no | fast |

## `end_session`

Close the conversation. Call when the task is complete rather than waiting for silence.

No parameters.

## `media_search`

Search the media library.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | Free-text search. |
| `limit` | integer |  | Maximum results. |

## `remember`

Store a durable fact about the current speaker.

Unknown speaker: `deny`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fact` | string | yes | The fact to retain. |
| `shareable` | boolean |  | Whether other household members may see this. |

## `speak`

Say something to the user. Runs concurrently with other tools; the model chooses when and whether to speak.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes | What to say. |
| `mode` | string |  | queue appends after current speech; preempt cancels it; interject ducks and cuts in. One of: `queue`, `preempt`, `interject`. |
